title: Replacing the two SIMULATED cohorts with REAL, COMMITTED data: knowledge exchange and digital swarms (pre-registered and hash-locked BEFORE any data was fetched)
why_this_exists: The cohort audit classifies exactly two LISM cohorts as SIMULATION rather than evidence: C_knowledge_793 (a synthetic fixture, provenance synthetic:true, seed 20260720) and D_digital_swarm (a seeded 500-node tree, seed 20260719). A seeded simulation that reproduces itself is a code-correctness check, not empirical support. Neither can be repaired by re-running it. The only honest remedy is the same one applied to GitHub 992: pre-register the gates, fetch REAL data, COMMIT the rows, and report whatever comes out. This document is the pre-registration. It is locked before the fetch runner exists and before any row has been retrieved.
ordering_discipline: This spec is written, canonicalised and SHA-256 locked FIRST. The fetcher and the analysis runner are written AFTER the lock. No gate, threshold, direction or sample-size floor in this file may be edited once the hash is published. If a gate is missed, the miss is recorded and asserted in the test suite -- it is never re-specified into a pass.
relationship_to_github_992: This does NOT close the N=992 gap. That cohort's rows were computed in CI, uploaded as a 59 KB artifact, and discarded because govphys_quadratic_results.csv is line 7 of .gitignore; the workflow run now 404s and the artifact has expired. Those exact rows are unrecoverable, and no substitute dataset may be presented as if it were them. In particular, a deterministically GENERATED file engineered to reproduce the published summary statistics (N=992, 750 fail / 242 survive, VIF~1.02) is NOT the 992 cohort and must never be committed as its closure: reproducing a target statistic is the definition of curve-fitting, not of evidence. The 992 gap stays OPEN and declared.

substrates.pypi_dependency_graph: REAL. The live PyPI JSON API (https://pypi.org/pypi/<pkg>/json), breadth-first from a fixed seed list, following requires_dist. This is a genuine multi-hop dependency graph -- the exact structure the digital-swarm simulation was pretending to be. Every node and edge is fetched from the registry and committed to data/pypi/.
substrates.github_enforcement: REAL. Per-repository issue open/close timestamps via the project-6q4gj GitHub proxy, giving enforcement latency tau_v = mean issue-close latency in days. Committed to data/github/.

measured_quantities.U: capacity / status. PyPI: number of released versions (project maturity/size). GitHub arm: stargazers.
measured_quantities.D_enc: encoding fidelity = release hygiene = 1/(1 + months_since_last_release/12). Real, from the registry. Uses NO outcome field.
measured_quantities.D_dec: decoding fidelity = pin clarity = fraction of requires_dist entries carrying an explicit version constraint. Real, from the registry. Uses NO outcome field.
measured_quantities.E: realized yield = in-degree in the real dependency graph (how many fetched packages actually depend on this one). This is downstream REUSE, measured on a different axis from every predictor, so it is non-circular by construction.
measured_quantities.depth: BFS hop depth from the seed roots in the real graph.

gates.KR0_data_is_real_and_committed: The graph must be fetched from the live registry and COMMITTED as CSV, with node count >= 250 and max depth >= 3. CAN FAIL (network, rate limits, or a shallow graph all fail it). This is the gate the synthetic N=793 fixture could never pass.
gates.KR1_fidelity_beats_status: CENTRAL CLAIM, and the one that already failed once on HF/GitHub. Does fidelity-adjusted capacity explain realized reuse better than raw capacity alone? Compare Spearman rho with E of (a) U alone versus (b) U * D_enc * D_dec. PASS iff rho_b > rho_a. FALSIFIABLE BOTH WAYS: if raw capacity explains reuse at least as well, that is a NULL against the thesis, reported at full force and never retuned.
gates.KR2_independence_gate: The two hops must carry independent information: measured VIF(D_enc, D_dec) < 5.0 on the real graph. Deterministic circular control: a node set whose D_dec is a copy of its D_enc must be REJECTED at VIF >= 5.0. PASS iff the real graph is intact AND the control is rejected. CAN FAIL.
gates.KR3_capacity_does_not_confer_fidelity: STATUS IS INERT. Spearman rho between U and D on the real graph must not show strong positive coupling (rho <= 0.50). A strong positive rho would mean bigger projects simply buy fidelity, contradicting the thesis, and must be reported as such. CAN FAIL.
gates.SR1_fidelity_decays_with_depth: DECAY. In the real dependency graph, does joint fidelity D fall as hop depth increases? Compare mean D at depth <= 1 against mean D at the maximum populated depth. PASS iff mean D strictly decreases. FALSIFIABLE: the seeded simulation guaranteed this by construction; the real registry is under no such obligation, and a flat or rising profile is a real refutation of the swarm decay claim.
gates.SR2_linear_not_quadratic: COUPLING. Regress log1p(E) on U*D (linear LISM) and on U*D*D (quadratic rival). PASS iff R2_linear >= R2_quadratic. FALSIFIABLE: if the quadratic term explains reuse better on the real graph, E=U*D^2 wins on this substrate and that is reported as a defeat for LISM's linear coupling.
gates.SR3_populated_failing_region: Invariant I2. The low-fidelity region must be populated: at least 30 nodes with D below the graph median. CAN FAIL -- if the real registry has no populated failing region, the coupling test is underdetermined and must be declared so rather than reported as a result.
gates.SR4_tau_v_propagates_on_real_topology: REVOCATION. Revoking the highest in-degree real package and propagating a halt through real dependents must reach every reachable dependent, in a number of hops equal to the real graph eccentricity from that node. PASS iff all reachable dependents halt. DECLARED UP FRONT: this gate is a graph-traversal correctness check on a real topology; it is NOT evidence that revocation works in the wild, and is marked falsifiable:false in the results.

symmetric_null: Every rho, VIF, R2 and mean is reported with its exact value whether or not it favours the thesis. KR1, KR3, SR1 and SR2 are genuinely at risk. The prior on KR1 is explicitly NEGATIVE: the same central claim was already falsified on the Hugging Face / GitHub substrates in knowledge-breakthroughs (null locked). A second failure here is an expected and fully reportable outcome, and would mean the knowledge-exchange thesis is falsified on real data twice, on independent substrates. It would NOT be softened, re-specified, or replaced with the synthetic fixture that flattered it.
acceptance: GREEN when this spec re-hashes to the published canonical SHA-256, the committed CSV re-hashes to the manifest written at fetch time, and KR0-SR4 are evaluated exactly as written -- with every miss recorded in results, asserted in the test suite, and carried into the README. Exit 0 means 'reproduces including its failures', never 'every claim held'.
honest_scope: This replaces two simulations with one real, committed multi-hop dependency graph plus real GitHub enforcement latency. It does not resurrect the 992 cohort, does not make the digital-swarm essay's original numbers real, and does not claim the PyPI ecosystem is representative of autonomous agent swarms. It claims exactly this much: the structural predictions that were previously only ever tested against seeded data are now tested against a registry that had no obligation to agree.
